<style>
  /* Layout: a simple tips page. Top tabs (Picks, Results, Performance, How it works); on Picks a row of
     market chips, then one panel with day buttons and matches grouped by competition, each match on
     one centred line with its picks as coloured pills underneath. No odds anywhere: probabilities only. */
  .fp { font-family: var(--font-anthropic-sans); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--cds-gap-lg); }
  .fp h1 { font-family: var(--font-anthropic-serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-title); margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; }
  .fp h2 { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-heading); font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; }
  .fp h3 { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-body); font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); margin: 0; }
  .fp p { margin: 0; }
  .fp .note { color: var(--color-fg-muted); font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); max-width: 75ch; line-height: 1.5; }
  .fp section.page { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--cds-gap-lg); }
  .fp .block { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--cds-gap-sm); }
  .fp :is(button, select, input, summary):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-fg); outline-offset: 2px; }

  /* header and tabs */
  .fp .head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
  .fp .status { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px var(--cds-gap-md); font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .status b { color: var(--color-fg); font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .live-dot { display: inline-block; width: .45rem; height: .45rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-ok); margin-right: .3rem; vertical-align: middle; }
  .fp .tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); }
  .fp .tabs button { font: inherit; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--color-fg-muted); padding: 10px 14px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; margin-bottom: -1px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .tabs button:hover { color: var(--color-fg); }
  .fp .tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--color-ok); border-bottom-color: var(--color-ok); }

  /* market chips */
  .fp .chiprow { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; scrollbar-width: thin; }
  .fp .chip { font: inherit; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); white-space: nowrap; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); background: var(--color-panel); color: var(--color-fg); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .fp .chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-ok); border-color: var(--color-ok); color: var(--color-bg); font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .chip i { width: .55rem; height: .55rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fam); }

  /* the picks panel */
  .fp .panel { background: var(--color-panel); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); border-radius: calc(var(--cds-radius) * 2); overflow: hidden; }
  .fp .panel-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: var(--cds-gap-sm) var(--cds-gap-md); padding: var(--cds-pad-lg); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); }
  .fp .panel-title { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
  .fp .panel-title h2 { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .03em; font-weight: 700; }
  .fp .panel-title .sub { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .panel-tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .fp .days { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; }
  .fp .days button, .fp .mini { font: inherit; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); border: 0; background: none; color: var(--color-fg-muted); padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }
  .fp .days button:hover, .fp .mini:hover { color: var(--color-fg); }
  .fp .days button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-ok); color: var(--color-bg); font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .mini { border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); }
  .fp .mini[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--color-fg); color: var(--color-fg); }
  .fp .panel select { font: inherit; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-fg); max-width: 14rem; }
  .fp .summary { padding: 8px var(--cds-pad-lg); font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); }
  .fp .comp-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px var(--cds-pad-lg); font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); background: var(--color-bg); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); }
  .fp .comp-head b { color: var(--color-fg); font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .comp-head .dot { width: .5rem; height: .5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-ok); }
  .fp .row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px var(--cds-pad-lg); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); }
  .fp .line { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; max-width: 40rem; }
  .fp .line .h { text-align: right; font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .fp .line .a { text-align: left; font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .fp .mid { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 4.2rem; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); border-radius: 999px; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.2; }
  .fp .mid .sc { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-body); font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-fg); }
  .fp .mid .ft { font-size: 10px; color: var(--color-fg-muted); letter-spacing: .05em; }
  .fp .pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; }
  .fp .pill { font: inherit; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--fam); background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-fg); cursor: pointer; }
  .fp .pill .fdot { width: .55rem; height: .55rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fam); flex: none; }
  .fp .pill b { font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .pill .pp { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .pill.hi .pp { color: var(--color-ok); font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .pill[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--fam); color: var(--color-bg); }
  .fp .pill[aria-pressed="true"] .pp { color: var(--color-bg); }
  .fp .pill[aria-pressed="true"] .fdot { background: var(--color-bg); }
  .fp .pill.won { border-color: var(--color-ok); } .fp .pill.lost { border-color: var(--color-bad); opacity: .8; }
  .fp .pill .res { font-weight: 700; } .fp .pill.won .res { color: var(--color-ok); } .fp .pill.lost .res { color: var(--color-bad); }
  .fp details.why { width: 100%; max-width: 40rem; }
  .fp details.why > summary { cursor: pointer; list-style: none; text-align: center; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp details.why > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  .fp details.why > summary::after { content: " ▾"; }
  .fp details.why[open] > summary::after { content: " ▴"; }
  .fp details.why > summary:hover { color: var(--color-fg); }
  .fp details.why ul { margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
  .fp details.why li { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); line-height: 1.5; border-left: 3px solid var(--fam); padding-left: 10px; }
  .fp details.why li b { color: var(--color-fg); font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .empty { color: var(--color-fg-muted); padding: var(--cds-pad-lg); text-align: center; }
  .fp .legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px var(--cds-gap-md); font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); padding: 10px var(--cds-pad-lg); }
  .fp .legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .fp .legend i { width: .55rem; height: .55rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fam); }

  .fp .panel input[type=date] { font: inherit; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-fg); }
  .fp .tag { display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-warn); color: var(--color-warn); margin-left: 6px; vertical-align: 1px; }

  /* competitions: ranking and grid */
  .fp .ctools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--cds-gap-sm) var(--cds-gap-md); align-items: center; }
  .fp .ctools .lbl { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp table.rank tbody tr { cursor: pointer; }
  .fp table.rank tbody tr:hover td { background: var(--color-bg); }
  .fp table.rank tbody tr.sel td { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ok) 14%, transparent); }
  .fp table.rank tbody tr.sel td:first-child { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--color-ok); }
  .fp table.rank tbody tr.small td { color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp table.rank td.big-n { font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .spark { display: block; overflow: visible; }
  .fp table.heat td.c { text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .fp table.heat td.c.thin { color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .sel-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ok) 14%, transparent); }
  .fp .sel-chip button { font: inherit; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--color-fg-muted); cursor: pointer; }

  .fp .pill.best-pill { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-body); padding: 9px 16px; border-width: 2px; }
  .fp .best-tag { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--color-ok); font-weight: 700; }
  .fp .pill[aria-pressed="true"] .best-tag { color: var(--color-bg); }
  .fp details.more-picks { width: 100%; max-width: 40rem; }
  .fp details.more-picks > summary { cursor: pointer; list-style: none; text-align: center; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp details.more-picks > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  .fp details.more-picks > summary::after { content: " ▾"; }
  .fp details.more-picks[open] > summary::after { content: " ▴"; }
  .fp details.more-picks .pills { margin-top: 8px; }

  .fp .row-comp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .row-comp .dot { width: .45rem; height: .45rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-ok); }

  .fp .sugg { border-color: var(--color-ok); }
  .fp .sugg-n { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .fp .sugg-n select { font: inherit; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-fg); }
  .fp .sugg-n .btn { width: 2rem; padding: 4px 0; text-align: center; }
  .fp .sugg-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--cds-gap-sm); }
  .fp .sugg-head h3 { margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .fp .sugg-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .55rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); }
  .fp .sugg-row .fdot { width: .55rem; height: .55rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fam); }
  .fp .sugg-row .m { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .sugg-row .pk { font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .sugg-row .pp { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .sugg-foot { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px var(--cds-gap-md); padding-top: 6px; }
  .fp .sugg-foot .btn { margin-left: auto; }

  /* slip */
  .fp .betslip { position: sticky; bottom: max(var(--cds-gap-sm), env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); z-index: 3; background: var(--color-panel); border: 1px solid var(--color-ok); border-radius: calc(var(--cds-radius) * 2); box-shadow: var(--cds-shadow-popover); padding: var(--cds-pad-sm) var(--cds-pad-md); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .fp .bs-sum { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px var(--cds-gap-md); }
  .fp .bs-title { font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .bs-fig { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: .35rem; }
  .fp .bs-fig .lbl { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .bs-fig .v { font-family: var(--font-anthropic-serif); font-size: var(--cds-font-size-heading); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .fp .bs-clear { margin-left: auto; }
  .fp .bs-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 11rem; overflow: auto; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); }
  .fp .bs-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .55rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 5px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); }
  .fp .bs-row .fdot { width: .55rem; height: .55rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fam); }
  .fp .bs-row .m { color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .bs-row button { font: inherit; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--color-fg-muted); cursor: pointer; }
  .fp .bs-note { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }

  /* results strip */
  .fp .strip { display: flex; gap: 10px; overflow-x: auto; padding: 4px 2px; }
  .fp .daytile { flex: none; width: 4.4rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 10px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); border-radius: var(--cds-radius); background: var(--color-panel); }
  .fp .daytile .mk { font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1; }
  .fp .daytile .mk.ok { color: var(--color-ok); } .fp .daytile .mk.bad { color: var(--color-bad); } .fp .daytile .mk.wait { color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .daytile .dd { font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .fp .daytile .mm, .fp .daytile .nn { font-size: 11px; color: var(--color-fg-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

  /* results portal, performance */
  .fp .filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--cds-gap-sm) var(--cds-gap-md); align-items: flex-end; background: var(--color-panel); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); border-radius: calc(var(--cds-radius) * 2); padding: var(--cds-pad-sm) var(--cds-pad-md); }
  .fp .field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
  .fp .field > .lbl { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .seg { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; }
  .fp .seg button { font: inherit; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-fg); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; }
  .fp .seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-ok); border-color: var(--color-ok); color: var(--color-bg); }
  .fp .filters select, .fp .filters input, .fp .btn { font: inherit; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-fg); min-width: 0; }
  .fp .btn { cursor: pointer; }
  .fp .chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
  .fp .kpis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 10rem), 1fr)); gap: var(--cds-gap-md); }
  .fp .kpi { background: var(--color-panel); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); border-radius: calc(var(--cds-radius) * 2); padding: var(--cds-pad-md) var(--cds-pad-lg); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
  .fp .kpi .lbl { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .kpi .big { font-family: var(--font-anthropic-serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-title); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.15; }
  .fp .kpi .sub { font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .fp .pos { color: var(--color-ok); } .fp .neg { color: var(--color-bad); }
  .fp .card { background: var(--color-panel); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); border-radius: calc(var(--cds-radius) * 2); padding: var(--cds-pad-lg); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--cds-gap-sm); min-width: 0; }
  .fp .grid2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 24rem), 1fr)); gap: var(--cds-gap-md); }
  .fp .chart { position: relative; min-height: 240px; }
  .fp .tip { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; background: var(--cds-surface-popover); border: 1px solid var(--cds-border); border-radius: var(--cds-radius); box-shadow: var(--cds-shadow-popover); padding: var(--cds-pad-xs) var(--cds-pad-sm); font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); white-space: nowrap; z-index: 2; }
  .fp .tip .t { color: var(--cds-text-secondary); }
  .fp .key { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--cds-gap-md); font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .key i { display: inline-block; width: .6rem; height: .6rem; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: .3rem; vertical-align: middle; }
  .fp .tbl-wrap { overflow: auto; max-height: 34rem; }
  .fp table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .fp th { text-align: left; font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); color: var(--color-fg-muted); position: sticky; top: 0; background: var(--color-panel); padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); white-space: nowrap; z-index: 1; }
  .fp td { padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); vertical-align: top; }
  .fp td.r, .fp th.r { text-align: right; }
  .fp td.pick-cell { border-left: 3px solid var(--fam); }
  .fp td .o-won { color: var(--color-ok); font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp td .o-lost { color: var(--color-bad); font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp td .o-pending { color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .src-test { color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .more { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--cds-gap-md); font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  .fp .banner { border: 1px solid var(--color-border-line); border-left: 4px solid var(--color-warn); border-radius: var(--cds-radius); padding: var(--cds-pad-sm) var(--cds-pad-md); background: var(--color-panel); font-size: var(--cds-font-size-caption); line-height: 1.5; }
  .fp .method { max-width: 75ch; }
  .fp .method ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 1.2rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--cds-gap-xs); line-height: 1.55; }
  .fp .method dl { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(7rem, max-content) 1fr; gap: 6px var(--cds-gap-md); line-height: 1.5; }
  .fp .method dt { font-weight: var(--cds-font-weight-medium); }
  .fp .method dd { margin: 0; color: var(--color-fg-muted); }
  @media (max-width: 40rem) {
    .fp .hide-sm { display: none; } .fp .method dl { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .fp .row { padding: 12px var(--cds-pad-md); } .fp .line { gap: 8px; } .fp .panel-head { padding: var(--cds-pad-md); }
  }
  [data-dash-source-state=empty] { color: transparent; }
  [data-dash-source-state=refreshing] { opacity: .5; transition: opacity var(--cds-dur-slow); }
  .fp .title-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .fp[data-sport="volley"] [data-only="football"], .fp[data-sport="football"] [data-only="volley"] { display: none !important; }
  .fp .perf-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--cds-gap-lg); }
  .fp .tabs .count { display: inline-block; min-width: 1.3rem; padding: 0 6px; margin-left: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-ok); color: var(--color-bg); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.3rem; text-align: center; }

    <div class="block" data-only="volley">
      <h2>How the volleyball picks are made</h2>
      <ul>
        <li><b>Every morning</b> the system saves yesterday's, today's and tomorrow's games from API-Volleyball, retrains, and makes picks for today and tomorrow (the free plan lists no further ahead).</li>
        <li><b>Team strength</b> comes from points won and lost in every set, recent games counting more, plus a league level so stronger leagues rate higher in the Champions League.</li>
        <li><b>From rallies to sets:</b> a side's chance of winning a rally gives its exact chance of winning a set to 25 (or the 5th set to 15), and from that every final score from 3-0 to 0-3.</li>
        <li><b>Best pick:</b> the safest option between 55% and 79% across winner, set handicap (±1.5, ±2.5), total sets (over/under 3.5 and 4.5) and 1st-set winner.</li>
        <li><b>No bookmaker prices</b> are available for volleyball from our free sources, so chances come from the ratings alone.</li>
        <li><b>Coverage:</b> Italy, Poland, Turkey, Brazil, Russia and Japan (men's and women's top leagues), Germany and France (men), and the CEV Champions League (men's; women's from this season).</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="block" data-only="football">
      <h2>How the picks are made</h2>
      <ul>
        <li><b>Every morning</b> the system downloads the latest results and fixtures, retrains on every match played so far, and makes picks for today and the next two days. Games that have already kicked off never get picks.</li>
        <li><b>Pick 1 (Result):</b> a straight Home or Away win when it is at least 65% likely; otherwise the safer Home/Draw or Away/Draw.</li>
        <li><b>Picks 2 and 3:</b> the safest option in two different markets (goals, corners or cards), between 55% and 85% likely, with at most one corners and one cards pick per match.</li>
        <li><b>Result and goal chances</b> come from bookmakers' prices with their margin removed, turned into expected goals for each side. Corners and cards come from each team's record, adjusted for how strong each side is.</li>
        <li><b>Settled on 90 minutes.</b> Extra time and penalties never count. League results come from football-data.co.uk; cup and European results from API-Football, which reports the 90-minute score separately from extra time and penalties.</li>
        <li><b>A match's picks are frozen on match day</b>, so the record always shows the last prediction made before kickoff.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>

These get Result and goals picks only. The Portuguese, Dutch, Belgian, Turkish, Greek and Scottish cups aren't available from our data sources.</p>
      <p class="note">Safe does not mean profitable: bookmakers' margins mean that even picks that win often can lose money over time, and SportyBet's prices are usually lower than other bookmakers'. Picks from the same match move together, so a same-match slip is riskier than its chance suggests.</p>

<script>
const pct = d3.format('.0%'), pct1 = d3.format('.1%'), num = d3.format(','), signed = d3.format('+.1%');
const N = (x) => (x === '' || x == null ? NaN : Number(x));
const FAMS_BY = { football: ['Result', 'Goals', 'Corners', 'Cards'], volley: ['Result', 'Sets'] };
let sport = (() => { try { return localStorage.getItem('sport') === 'volley' ? 'volley' : 'football'; } catch (e) { return 'football'; } })();
let FAMS = FAMS_BY[sport];
// volleyball reads its own files, which have the same columns
const VSETS = { upcoming: 'volley_upcoming', history: 'volley_history', status: 'volley_status', league_seasons: 'volley_league_seasons' };
const D = (name) => dash.data(sport === 'volley' && VSETS[name] ? VSETS[name] : name);
const famColor = (f) => dash.colors[FAMS.indexOf(f)] || 'var(--cds-chart-muted)';
const asDay = (s) => new Date(`${s}T00:00:00Z`);
const localDay = (offset = 0) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`; };
const dayName = (s) => (s === localDay(0) ? 'Today' : s === localDay(1) ? 'Tomorrow' : s === localDay(-1) ? 'Yesterday' : d3.utcFormat('%A')(asDay(s)));
const el = (tag, cls, text) => { const e = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) e.className = cls; if (text != null) e.textContent = text; return e; };
const mark = (e, source, field, where) => { e.setAttribute('data-source', source); e.setAttribute('data-field', field); e.setAttribute('data-where', where); return e; };

// competition label "Country: Competition"
const CUP_COUNTRY = { 'EFL Cup': 'England', 'FA Cup': 'England', 'DFB-Pokal': 'Germany', 'Copa del Rey': 'Spain', 'Coppa Italia': 'Italy', 'Coupe de France': 'France',
  'Champions League': 'Europe', 'Europa League': 'Europe', 'Conference League': 'Europe' };
const compParts = (name) => (CUP_COUNTRY[name] ? [CUP_COUNTRY[name], name] : [name.split(' ')[0], name.split(' ').slice(1).join(' ')]);
const COMP_ORDER = ['Champions League', 'Europa League', 'Conference League', 'England Premier League', 'Spain La Liga', 'Italy Serie A', 'Germany Bundesliga', 'France Ligue 1'];
const compRank = (c) => { const i = COMP_ORDER.indexOf(c); return i < 0 ? 99 : i; };

// market chips: label -> test on a pick {label, market, family, p}
const CHIPS_BY = { football: [
  ['All markets', () => true], ['Safest (80%+)', (k) => k.p >= 0.8],
  ['Home / Away win', (k) => k.label === 'Home' || k.label === 'Away'], ['Double chance', (k) => k.label === 'Home/Draw' || k.label === 'Away/Draw'],
  ['Over / Under', (k) => k.market === 'Over/Under' || k.market === '1st Half Over/Under'], ['Both teams to score', (k) => k.market === 'GG/NG'],
  ['Team goals', (k) => k.market === 'Home Team Over/Under' || k.market === 'Away Team Over/Under'],
  ['Corners', (k) => k.family === 'Corners'], ['Cards', (k) => k.family === 'Cards'],
], volley: [
  ['All markets', () => true], ['Safest (75%+)', (k) => k.p >= 0.75],
  ['Winner', (k) => k.market === 'Winner'], ['Set handicap', (k) => k.market === 'Set Handicap'],
  ['Total sets', (k) => k.market === 'Total Sets'], ['1st set', (k) => k.market === '1st Set Winner'],
] };
let CHIPS = CHIPS_BY[sport];

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ tabs
const PAGES = ['picks', 'slip', 'results', 'about'];
const OLD_PAGES = { performance: 'about', method: 'about' };
let page = (() => { const h = location.hash.slice(1); return PAGES.includes(h) ? h : OLD_PAGES[h] || 'picks'; })();
function showPage(p) {
  page = p;
  PAGES.forEach((id) => { document.getElementById(id).hidden = id !== p; document.getElementById(`tab-${id}`).setAttribute('aria-selected', id === p); });
  dash.setLink(p);
  draw();
}
document.querySelectorAll('.tabs button').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => showPage(b.dataset.page)));
function segment(box, get, set) {
  box.querySelectorAll('button').forEach((b) => { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.dataset.v === get()); b.onclick = () => { set(b.dataset.v); draw(); }; });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ status
function drawStatus() {
  const s = D('status');
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-source="status"]').forEach((e) => {
    e.classList.toggle('dash-skeleton', s.status === 'loading');
    if (s.status !== 'ok' || !s.data.length || !s.data[0][e.dataset.field]) { e.textContent = '—'; return; }
    const v = s.data[0][e.dataset.field];
    e.textContent = e.dataset.field === 'updated_at' ? d3.utcFormat('%a %-d %b, %H:%M')(new Date(`${v.replace(' ', 'T')}:00Z`)) : d3.utcFormat('%a %-d %b')(asDay(v));
  });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ picks
const ps = { chip: 0, day: localDay(0), comp: '', safest: true, whyAll: false, more: false };
const openMore = new Set();
let suggN = 3, suggPicks = [], suggMax = 3, suggMode = 'n', suggSpan = '1';
const nextDay = (s) => d3.utcFormat('%Y-%m-%d')(new Date(asDay(s).getTime() + 864e5));
const SB = 0.95;   // SportyBet's price is estimated at about 5% below fair odds (1 / chance)
// safest best picks, one per match, until the estimated SportyBet total reaches the target
function toOdds(pool, target) {
  const out = []; let odds = 1;
  for (const x of pool) { out.push(x); odds *= SB / x.p; if (odds >= target) return out; }
  return null;
}   // suggN 0 = all of the day's best picks
const trackCache = new Map();
// how often a daily slip of the n safest best picks won, from the test picks (Aug 2025 on)
function slipTrack(n) {
  const h = D('history');
  if (h.status !== 'ok') return null;
  const key = `${suggSpan}|${n}`;
  if (!trackCache.has(key)) {
    const byDay = d3.group(h.data.filter((r) => r.source === 'Test' && r.slot === 'Best' && r.outcome !== 'pending'), (r) => r.date);
    const days = [...byDay.keys()].map((d) => (suggSpan === '2' ? [...byDay.get(d), ...(byDay.get(nextDay(d)) || [])] : byDay.get(d))
      .slice().sort((a, b) => N(b.prob) - N(a.prob)));
    let slips;
    if (typeof n === 'string') {   // "odds:5"
      const target = Number(n.split(':')[1]);
      slips = days.map((v) => toOdds(v.map((r) => ({ p: N(r.prob), r })), target)).filter(Boolean).map((l) => l.map((x) => x.r));
    } else slips = days.filter((v) => v.length >= n).map((v) => v.slice(0, n));
    const won = slips.filter((l) => l.every((r) => r.outcome === 'won')).length;
    trackCache.set(key, slips.length ? [won / slips.length, slips.length] : null);
  }
  return trackCache.get(key);
}
const suggSel = document.getElementById('sugg-n');
suggSel.addEventListener('change', () => { suggN = Number(suggSel.value); draw(); });
document.getElementById('sugg-minus').addEventListener('click', () => { const n = suggN || suggMax; suggN = Math.max(2, n - 1); draw(); });
document.getElementById('sugg-plus').addEventListener('click', () => { if (suggN) suggN = suggN + 1 >= suggMax ? 0 : suggN + 1; draw(); });
document.getElementById('sugg-add').addEventListener('click', () => {
  slip.clear();
  suggPicks.forEach(({ m, k }) => slip.set(m.id, legOf(m, k)));
  saveSlip(); draw();
});
// my slip: one pick per game, keyed by match id; kept in this browser per sport
const slip = new Map();
const legOf = (m, k) => ({ id: m.id, i: k.i, home: m.home, away: m.away, comp: m.comp, date: m.date, time: m.time,
  label: k.label, market: k.market, family: k.family, p: k.p, won: k.won,
  options: m.picks.map((x) => ({ i: x.i, label: x.label, market: x.market, family: x.family, p: x.p, won: x.won })) });
function saveSlip() { try { localStorage.setItem(`slip-${sport}`, JSON.stringify([...slip.values()])); } catch (e) { /* not remembered */ } }
function loadSlip() {
  slip.clear();
  try { (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`slip-${sport}`) || '[]') || []).filter((l) => l.date >= localDay(-1)).forEach((l) => slip.set(l.id, l)); } catch (e) { /* empty slip */ }
}
const openWhy = new Set();
document.getElementById('comp').addEventListener('change', (e) => { ps.comp = e.target.value; draw(); });
const pickDate = document.getElementById('pickdate');
pickDate.addEventListener('change', () => { if (pickDate.value && pickDate.validity.valid) { ps.day = pickDate.value; draw(); } });
pickDate.addEventListener('blur', () => { pickDate.value = ps.day; });
document.getElementById('sort').addEventListener('click', (e) => { ps.safest = !ps.safest; e.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-pressed', !ps.safest); draw(); });

// matches for a day: upcoming file for today onward, history file (live picks) for earlier days
function matchesFor(day) {
  const u = D('upcoming'), h = D('history');
  if (u.status === 'ok' && u.data.some((m) => m.date === day)) {
    return u.data.filter((m) => m.date === day).map((m) => ({
      id: m.match_id, src: 'upcoming', date: m.date, time: m.time, comp: m.league, home: m.home, away: m.away, result: m.result,
      picks: [0, 1, 2, 3].filter((i) => m[`pick${i}`]).map((i) => ({
        i, key: `${m.match_id}|${i}`, label: m[`pick${i}`], market: m[`pick${i}_market`], family: m[`pick${i}_family`], p: N(m[`pick${i}_prob`]),
        won: m[`pick${i}_won`], why: m[`pick${i}_why`], support: m[`pick${i}_support`] })),
    }));
  }
  if (h.status === 'ok') {
    let rows = h.data.filter((r) => r.date === day && r.source !== 'Test');
    const test = !rows.length;                     // no live picks that day: show the test picks
    if (test) rows = h.data.filter((r) => r.date === day && r.source === 'Test');
    const list = d3.groups(rows, (r) => r.match_id).map(([id, rs]) => ({
      id, src: 'history', date: day, time: '', comp: rs[0].competition, home: rs[0].home, away: rs[0].away, result: rs[0].result,
      picks: rs.sort((a, b) => (a.slot === 'Best' ? -1 : b.slot === 'Best' ? 1 : a.slot.localeCompare(b.slot))).map((r) => ({
        i: r.slot === 'Best' ? 0 : Number(r.slot.slice(-1)), key: r.pick_id, pickId: r.pick_id, label: r.pick, market: r.market, family: r.family, p: N(r.prob),
        won: r.outcome === 'pending' ? '' : r.outcome, why: '', support: '' })),
    }));
    list.test = test && list.length > 0;
    return list;
  }
  return [];
}

function pillFor(m, k) {
  const pill = el('button', `pill${k.p >= 0.8 ? ' hi' : ''}${k.won ? ` ${k.won}` : ''}`);
  pill.style.setProperty('--fam', famColor(k.family));
  const on = slip.get(m.id)?.i === k.i;
  pill.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on);
  pill.title = `${k.family} · ${k.market}${on ? ' · on your slip (tap to remove)' : slip.has(m.id) ? ' · tap to swap your pick for this game' : ' · tap to add to your slip'}`;
  const where = m.src === 'upcoming' ? `match_id=${encodeURIComponent(m.id)}` : `pick_id=${encodeURIComponent(k.pickId)}`;
  const lbl = el('b', null, k.label), pp = el('span', 'pp', pct(k.p));
  if (m.src === 'upcoming') { mark(lbl, 'upcoming', `pick${k.i}`, where); mark(pp, 'upcoming', `pick${k.i}_prob`, where); }
  else { mark(lbl, 'history', 'pick', where); mark(pp, 'history', 'prob', where); }
  if (k.won) pill.append(el('span', 'res', k.won === 'won' ? '✓' : '✗'));
  pill.append(el('span', 'fdot'), lbl, pp);
  pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (on) slip.delete(m.id); else slip.set(m.id, legOf(m, k));
    saveSlip(); draw();
  });
  return pill;
}

function matchRow(m, test) {
  const row = el('div', 'row'); row.id = `m-${m.id}`;
  const line = el('div', 'line');
  const mid = el('span', 'mid');
  if (m.result) { mid.append(el('span', 'sc', m.result.replace('-', ' – ')), el('span', 'ft', 'FT')); }
  else mid.append(el('span', null, m.time || '—'));
  const h = el('span', 'h', m.home), a = el('span', 'a', m.away);
  if (m.src === 'upcoming') { mark(h, 'upcoming', 'home', `match_id=${encodeURIComponent(m.id)}`); mark(a, 'upcoming', 'away', `match_id=${encodeURIComponent(m.id)}`); }
  line.append(h, mid, a);
  const pills = el('div', 'pills');
  const best = m.picks.find((k) => k.i === 0);
  const others = m.picks.filter((k) => k.i !== 0);
  if (best) {
    const bp = pillFor(m, best); bp.classList.add('best-pill');
    const tag = el('span', 'best-tag', 'Best pick'); bp.prepend(tag);
    pills.append(bp);
  } else others.filter(test).forEach((k) => pills.append(pillFor(m, k)));   // older days, before the best pick
  row.append(line, pills);
  if (others.length && (best || sport === 'volley')) {
    const op = el('div', 'pills');
    op.append(el('span', 'other-label', best ? 'Other options' : 'Options'));
    others.forEach((k) => op.append(pillFor(m, k)));
    row.append(op);
  }
  const withWhy = (best ? [best] : m.picks.filter(test)).filter((k) => k.why);
  if (withWhy.length) {
    const box = el('details', 'why');
    box.append(el('summary', null, best ? 'Why this pick' : 'Why these picks'));
    const ul = el('ul');
    withWhy.forEach((k) => {
      const li = el('li'); li.style.setProperty('--fam', famColor(k.family));
      li.append(el('b', null, `${k.label} · ${pct(k.p)}. `), document.createTextNode(`${k.support}. ${k.why}`));
      ul.append(li);
    });
    box.append(ul);
    box.open = openWhy.has(m.id);
    box.addEventListener('toggle', () => { if (box.open) openWhy.add(m.id); else openWhy.delete(m.id); });
    row.append(box);
  }
  return row;
}

function drawPicks() {
  const st = D('status'), u = D('upcoming');
  document.getElementById('chips').replaceChildren(...CHIPS.map(([label], j) => {
    const b = el('button', 'chip', label); b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', ps.chip === j);
    b.addEventListener('click', () => { ps.chip = j; draw(); }); return b;
  }));
  // days: yesterday + the prediction window
  let days = [localDay(-1)];
  if (st.status === 'ok' && st.data.length && st.data[0].window_from) {
    for (let t = asDay(st.data[0].window_from); t <= asDay(st.data[0].window_to); t = new Date(t.getTime() + 864e5)) days.push(d3.utcFormat('%Y-%m-%d')(t));
  } else if (u.status === 'ok') days = days.concat([...new Set(u.data.map((m) => m.date))].sort());
  days = [...new Set(days)].sort();
  // any day from the first recorded pick to the end of the window; buttons for the nearest ones
  const hd = D('history');
  const minDay = hd.status === 'ok' && hd.data.length ? d3.min(hd.data, (r) => r.date) : days[0];
  const maxDay = days[days.length - 1];
  if (!ps.day || ps.day < minDay || ps.day > maxDay) ps.day = days.find((d) => d >= localDay(0)) || maxDay;
  const dayBox = document.getElementById('days');
  dayBox.replaceChildren(...days.map((d) => { const b = el('button', null, dayName(d)); b.dataset.v = d; return b; }));
  segment(dayBox, () => ps.day, (v) => { ps.day = v; });
  const dp = document.getElementById('pickdate');
  dp.min = minDay; dp.max = maxDay;
  if (dp !== document.activeElement) dp.value = ps.day;
  document.getElementById('day-title').textContent = d3.utcFormat('%A %-d %B %Y')(asDay(ps.day));
  document.getElementById('legend').replaceChildren(...FAMS.map((f) => { const s = el('span'); const i = el('i'); i.style.setProperty('--fam', famColor(f)); s.append(i, document.createTextNode(f)); return s; }));

  const list = document.getElementById('list');
  const summary = document.getElementById('summary');
  list.classList.toggle('dash-skeleton', u.status === 'loading');
  if (u.status !== 'ok') { list.replaceChildren(); summary.textContent = u.status === 'error' ? 'Failed to load' : '—'; return; }

  const all = matchesFor(ps.day);
  const comps = [...new Set(all.map((m) => m.comp))].sort((a, b) => compRank(a) - compRank(b) || a.localeCompare(b));
  const sel = document.getElementById('comp');
  sel.replaceChildren(new Option('All competitions', ''), ...comps.map((c) => new Option(compParts(c).join(': '), c)));
  if (!comps.includes(ps.comp)) ps.comp = '';
  sel.value = ps.comp;
  const test = CHIPS[ps.chip][1];
  // volleyball games with a team we have too few games for get no best pick: left out
  const main = (m) => { const b = m.picks.find((k) => k.i === 0); return b ? [b] : sport === 'volley' ? [] : m.picks; };
  const shown = all.filter((m) => (!ps.comp || m.comp === ps.comp) && main(m).some(test));
  const picks = shown.flatMap((m) => main(m).filter(test));
  const settled = picks.filter((k) => k.won);
  summary.replaceChildren(document.createTextNode(shown.length
    ? `${num(shown.length)} matches · ${num(picks.length)} best picks · ${num(picks.filter((k) => k.p >= 0.8).length)} at 80% or more` +
      (settled.length ? ` · ${num(settled.filter((k) => k.won === 'won').length)} of ${num(settled.length)} settled picks won` : '')
      + (sport === 'volley' && all.some((m) => !main(m).length) ? ` · ${num(all.filter((m) => !main(m).length).length)} games left out (a team with too few past games)` : '')
    : ''));
  if (all.test) {
    const t = el('span', 'tag', 'Test picks'); t.title = 'No live picks were made this day; these come from the backtest, each made using only earlier matches.';
    summary.append(t);
  }
  if (!shown.length) {
    list.replaceChildren(el('p', 'empty', all.length ? 'No picks in this market for this day.'
      : ps.day < localDay(0) ? (sport === 'volley' ? 'No picks recorded for this day (volleyball test picks cover the 2024/25 season).' : 'No picks recorded for this day (test picks cover league games from August 2025).') : 'No fixtures listed for this day yet. The daily update adds them as soon as they are published.'));
    return;
  }
  const best = (m) => d3.max(main(m).filter(test), (k) => k.p);
  const nodes = [];
  if (ps.safest) {   // one list, highest chance first, competition shown on each game
    shown.slice().sort((a, b) => best(b) - best(a) || (a.time || '').localeCompare(b.time || '')).forEach((m) => {
      const row = matchRow(m, test);
      const [country, name] = compParts(m.comp);
      const c = el('div', 'row-comp'); c.append(el('span', 'dot'), document.createTextNode(`${country}: ${name}${m.time && !m.result ? ' · ' + m.time : ''}`));
      row.prepend(c);
      nodes.push(row);
    });
  } else {
    const groups = d3.groups(shown, (m) => m.comp).sort((a, b) => compRank(a[0]) - compRank(b[0]) || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
    for (const [comp, ms] of groups) {
      const head = el('div', 'comp-head'); const [country, name] = compParts(comp);
      head.append(el('span', 'dot'), document.createTextNode(`${country}: `), el('b', null, name));
      nodes.push(head);
      ms.slice().sort((a, b) => (a.time || '').localeCompare(b.time || '')).forEach((m) => nodes.push(matchRow(m, test)));
    }
  }
  list.replaceChildren(...nodes);
}

function drawSuggested() {
  segment(document.getElementById('sugg-span'), () => suggSpan, (v) => { suggSpan = v; });
  const all = suggSpan === '2' ? [...matchesFor(ps.day), ...matchesFor(nextDay(ps.day))] : matchesFor(ps.day);
  const pool = all.map((m) => ({ m, k: m.picks.find((x) => x.i === 0) })).filter((x) => x.k).sort((a, b) => b.k.p - a.k.p);
  suggMax = Math.max(2, pool.length);
  if (suggN >= suggMax) suggN = 0;
  suggSel.replaceChildren(...d3.range(2, suggMax).map((n) => new Option(`${n}`, n)), new Option(`All (${pool.length})`, 0));
  suggSel.value = String(suggN);
  document.getElementById('sugg-minus').disabled = suggN === 2;
  document.getElementById('sugg-plus').disabled = suggN === 0;
  segment(document.getElementById('sugg-mode'), () => suggMode, (v) => { suggMode = v; });
  document.getElementById('sugg-n-box').hidden = suggMode !== 'n';
  const target = suggMode === 'n' ? 0 : Number(suggMode);
  const legs = target ? (toOdds(pool.map((x) => ({ ...x, p: x.k.p })), target) || []) : suggN ? pool.slice(0, suggN) : pool;
  suggPicks = legs;
  const box = document.getElementById('sugg-list');
  document.getElementById('sugg-title').textContent = `Quick slip · ${dayName(ps.day)}${suggSpan === '2' ? ' + ' + dayName(nextDay(ps.day)) : ''}`;
  document.getElementById('sugg-sub').textContent = legs.length
    ? (target ? `The day's safest best picks, one per match, until the total reaches about ${target} odds.` : `The ${legs.length} safest best picks of the day, each from a different match.`) : '';
  if (legs.length < 2) {
    box.replaceChildren(el('p', 'note', target ? `This day's best picks don't add up to ${target} odds.` : 'Not enough best picks on this day for a slip.'));
    document.getElementById('sugg-chance').textContent = '—'; document.getElementById('sugg-track').textContent = '';
    document.getElementById('sugg-add').hidden = true; return;
  }

  const data = d3.rollups(settled, (v) => ({ n: v.length, won: v.filter((r) => r.outcome === 'won').length / v.length, pred: d3.mean(v, (r) => N(r.prob)) }), (r) => r.date.slice(0, 7))
    .map(([m, v]) => ({ m, ...v })).sort((a, b) => a.m.localeCompare(b.m));
  if (!data.length) { box.append(el('p', 'note', 'No settled picks match these filters.')); return; }
  const W = box.clientWidth || 400, H = 240, mg = { t: 12, r: 8, b: 30, l: 40 };
  const x = d3.scaleBand(data.map((d) => d.m), [mg.l, W - mg.r]).padding(0.25);
  const lo = Math.max(0, Math.floor((d3.min(data, (d) => Math.min(d.won, d.pred)) - 0.05) * 10) / 10);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear([lo, 1], [H - mg.b, mg.t]);
  const svg = d3.select(box).append('svg').attr('width', '100%').attr('viewBox', `0 0 ${W} ${H}`);
  svg.append('g').selectAll('line').data(y.ticks(5)).join('line').attr('x1', mg.l).attr('x2', W - mg.r).attr('y1', (v) => y(v)).attr('y2', (v) => y(v)).attr('stroke', 'var(--cds-chart-grid)');
  svg.append('g').attr('transform', `translate(${mg.l},0)`).call(d3.axisLeft(y).ticks(5).tickFormat(pct).tickSize(0)).attr('font-size', null).attr('font-family', null)
    .call((g) => g.select('.domain').remove()).selectAll('text').attr('fill', 'var(--color-fg-muted)').style('font-size', 'var(--cds-font-size-caption)');
  const every = Math.ceil(data.length / Math.max(1, Math.floor((W - mg.l) / 56)));
  svg.append('g').attr('transform', `translate(0,${H - mg.b})`)
    .call(d3.axisBottom(x).tickSize(0).tickValues(data.map((d) => d.m).filter((_, i) => i % every === 0)).tickFormat((m) => d3.utcFormat('%b %y')(new Date(`${m}-01T00:00:00Z`))))
    .attr('font-size', null).attr('font-family', null).call((g) => g.select('.domain').attr('stroke', 'var(--cds-chart-axis)'))
    .selectAll('text').attr('fill', 'var(--color-fg-muted)').attr('dy', '1.2em').style('font-size', 'var(--cds-font-size-caption)');
  const g = svg.append('g').selectAll('g').data(data).join('g');
  g.append('rect').attr('x', (d) => x(d.m)).attr('width', x.bandwidth()).attr('y', (d) => y(d.won)).attr('height', (d) => y(lo) - y(d.won)).attr('rx', 3).attr('fill', dash.colors[0]).attr('opacity', 0.85);
  g.append('circle').attr('cx', (d) => x(d.m) + x.bandwidth() / 2).attr('cy', (d) => y(d.pred)).attr('r', 3.5).attr('fill', 'var(--color-fg)');
  const tip = el('div', 'tip'); tip.hidden = true; box.append(tip);
  g.append('rect').attr('x', (d) => x(d.m)).attr('width', x.bandwidth()).attr('y', mg.t).attr('height', H - mg.t - mg.b).attr('fill', 'transparent')
    .on('mousemove', (ev, d) => {
      tip.replaceChildren(el('div', 't', `${d3.utcFormat('%B %Y')(new Date(`${d.m}-01T00:00:00Z`))} · ${num(d.n)} picks`), el('div', null, `Won ${pct1(d.won)}`), el('div', null, `Predicted ${pct1(d.pred)}`));
      tip.hidden = false;
      const [px, py] = d3.pointer(ev, box);
      tip.style.left = `${Math.min(Math.max(0, px + 12), box.clientWidth - tip.offsetWidth)}px`; tip.style.top = `${Math.max(0, py - 10)}px`;
    })
    .on('mouseleave', () => { tip.hidden = true; });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ performance
function drawTiles(source = 'backtest_slots') {
  const d = dash.data(source);
  document.querySelectorAll(`#performance [data-source="${source}"]`).forEach((e) => {
    e.classList.toggle('dash-skeleton', d.status === 'loading');
    if (d.status !== 'ok') { e.textContent = '—'; return; }
    const slot = e.getAttribute('data-where').split('=')[1];
    const r = d.data.find((x) => x.slot === slot);
    const f = e.getAttribute('data-field');
    e.textContent = r ? (f === 'n' ? num(N(r[f])) : pct1(N(r[f]))) : '—';
  });
}
function drawTable(id, source, cols) {
  const tb = document.querySelector(`#${id} tbody`);
  const d = dash.data(source);
  if (d.status !== 'ok') { tb.replaceChildren(); return; }
  tb.replaceChildren(...d.data.map((r) => {
    const tr = el('tr');
    for (const [c, fmt] of cols) {
      const v = r[c];
      const td = el('td', fmt ? 'r' : '', fmt ? (v === '' || v == null ? '' : fmt(N(v))) : v);
      if (c === 'family') { td.className = 'pick-cell'; td.style.setProperty('--fam', famColor(v)); }
      tr.append(td);
    }
    return tr;
  }));
}
function drawReliability() {
  const box = document.getElementById('rel-chart');
  const d = dash.data('cat1_reliability');
  document.getElementById('key-actual').style.background = dash.colors[0];
  box.replaceChildren();
  box.classList.toggle('dash-skeleton', d.status === 'loading');
  if (d.status !== 'ok') return;
  const rows = d.data.map((r) => ({ bucket: r.bucket, n: N(r.n), pred: N(r.predicted), hit: N(r.hit_rate) }));
  const W = box.clientWidth || 400, H = 240, m = { t: 12, r: 12, b: 40, l: 40 };
  const x = d3.scaleBand(rows.map((r) => r.bucket), [m.l, W - m.r]).padding(0.3);
  const lo = Math.max(0, Math.floor((d3.min(rows, (r) => Math.min(r.pred, r.hit)) - 0.05) * 10) / 10);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear([lo, 1], [H - m.b, m.t]);
  const svg = d3.select(box).append('svg').attr('width', '100%').attr('viewBox', `0 0 ${W} ${H}`);
  svg.append('g').selectAll('line').data(y.ticks(5)).join('line').attr('x1', m.l).attr('x2', W - m.r).attr('y1', (v) => y(v)).attr('y2', (v) => y(v)).attr('stroke', 'var(--cds-chart-grid)');
  svg.append('g').attr('transform', `translate(${m.l},0)`).call(d3.axisLeft(y).ticks(5).tickFormat(pct).tickSize(0)).attr('font-size', null).attr('font-family', null)
    .call((g) => g.select('.domain').remove()).selectAll('text').attr('fill', 'var(--color-fg-muted)').style('font-size', 'var(--cds-font-size-caption)');
  svg.append('g').attr('transform', `translate(0,${H - m.b})`).call(d3.axisBottom(x).tickSize(0)).attr('font-size', null).attr('font-family', null)
    .call((g) => g.select('.domain').attr('stroke', 'var(--cds-chart-axis)')).selectAll('text').attr('fill', 'var(--color-fg-muted)').attr('dy', '1.2em').style('font-size', 'var(--cds-font-size-caption)');
  const g = svg.append('g').selectAll('g').data(rows).join('g').attr('transform', (r) => `translate(${x(r.bucket) + x.bandwidth() / 2},0)`);
  g.append('line').attr('y1', (r) => y(r.pred)).attr('y2', (r) => y(r.hit)).attr('stroke', 'var(--cds-chart-grid)').attr('stroke-width', 2);
  g.append('circle').attr('cy', (r) => y(r.pred)).attr('r', 5).attr('fill', 'var(--cds-chart-muted)');
  g.append('circle').attr('cy', (r) => y(r.hit)).attr('r', 5).attr('fill', dash.colors[0]);
  const tip = el('div', 'tip'); tip.hidden = true; box.append(tip);
  g.append('rect').attr('x', -x.bandwidth() / 2).attr('width', x.bandwidth()).attr('y', m.t).attr('height', H - m.t - m.b).attr('fill', 'transparent')
    .on('mousemove', (ev, r) => {
      tip.replaceChildren(el('div', 't', `Confidence ${r.bucket} · ${num(r.n)} picks`), el('div', null, `Predicted ${pct1(r.pred)}`), el('div', null, `Won ${pct1(r.hit)}`));
      tip.hidden = false;
      const [px, py] = d3.pointer(ev, box);
      tip.style.left = `${Math.min(Math.max(0, px + 12), box.clientWidth - tip.offsetWidth)}px`; tip.style.top = `${py - 10}px`;
    })
    .on('mouseleave', () => { tip.hidden = true; });
}
function drawPerformance() {
  if (sport === 'volley') {
    drawTiles('volley_backtest_best');
    drawTable('v-rel-table', 'volley_reliability', [['band'], ['n', num], ['predicted', pct1], ['hit_rate', pct1]]);
    drawTable('v-league-table', 'volley_leagues', [['league'], ['n', num], ['predicted', pct1], ['hit_rate', pct1]]);
    drawTable('v-mkt-table', 'volley_markets', [['family'], ['category'], ['option'], ['n', num], ['predicted', pct1], ['hit_rate', pct1]]);

  }
  drawTiles();

  drawTable('league-table', 'league_cat1', [['league'], ['n', num], ['predicted', pct1], ['hit_rate', pct1]]);
  drawTable('support-table', 'support_check', [['band'], ['agrees', pct1], ['mostly_agrees', pct1], ['split', pct1]]);
  drawTable('opt-table', 'backtest_options', [['family'], ['category'], ['option'], ['n', num], ['predicted', pct1], ['hit_rate', pct1]]);
}
